description: All 40 tables in lib/db/schema.ts. Auth tables are the identity core; content/media feed the app; social/payment tables drive the economy. FKs are logical (Drizzle relations) unless noted.

identity.users: Accounts: email, username, password_hash, role (user/creator), two_fa_enabled, avatar, deleted flag. Deleting frees the identity for re-registration.
identity.profiles: Public profile: display name, bio, avatar, banner, links, verification badge.
identity.sessions: Auth sessions (device rows) used by lib/auth/session.ts.
identity.refresh_tokens: Hashed refresh tokens with unique token_hash index (jti guarantees uniqueness); rotation + revocation live here.
identity.devices: Registered devices (push tokens, biometric credential ids).
identity.verification_codes: 6-digit codes for email verification, 2FA, password reset; expiry enforced.
identity.credential_grants: Credential-broker grants (token lifecycle for the credentials/* routes).

content.posts: Posts: creator_id, caption, media, tier/gating (free/subscriber/paid), price, status (draft/published/archived), publish flow via POST /posts/:id/publish.
content.media: Media rows: mediaType (image/video), urls (from R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL), dimensions, duration, thumbnail, qualities (Stream HLS), immutable CacheControl.
content.post_views: View rows deduped per account (one counted view per account per post).
content.albums: Paid albums: creator_id, title, description, unlock_price (authoritative pricing), cover, is_published.
content.album_unlocks: Purchases: user_id + album_id (one row per unlock).
content.comments: Comments in a room: author, body, counts.

social.subscriptions: Creator subscriptions: subscriber_id, creator_id, tier, status (active/cancelled), price, period. Server resolves per-viewer subscription state.
social.creator_settings: Creator profile settings: messaging permission, payout prefs, subscription tiers.

messaging.chat_rooms: DM rooms (direct or group); strictly scoped to authenticated user.
messaging.chat_room_messages: Messages: sender, body, media refs, edited/deleted flags, reactions.

economy.transactions: Ledger: type (deposit/withdraw/subscribe/album_unlock), amount, status, refs to paystack/webhook. Wallet + transactions updated atomically.
economy.upload_sessions: Direct-to-R2 upload sessions: status, part tracking, etags, target media metadata. Created by POST /uploads, completed by POST /uploads/:id/complete.

system.notifications: Notification feed: type (like/comment/subscribe/message/new_post/withdrawal), actor, target, read flag.
system.shares: Share tokens: short token → { type: post|album|creator, targetId } for deep links.

migration_notes.how: pnpm migrate runs scripts/migrate.ts (idempotent). Add new tables there or via Drizzle generate + migrate.
migration_notes.recent: upload_sessions (direct-to-R2), album_unlocks, chat_rooms*, comment_rooms*, shares, transactions, two_fa_enabled on users — all applied in recent commits; live DB must be migrated before deploy.
